verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships an official MCP server, either hosted at api.perplexity.ai/mcp or run locally over stdio. It exposes its search and reasoning as ready-made tools for AI assistants, with tool-restriction controls and an MCP-connector example for Messages API requests. A `pplx` CLI also returns structured JSON explicitly intended for agent tool calls, and an OpenAPI spec is published. Missing for 10: published function-calling (tool JSON) schemas for the search endpoint itself, named agent-framework integrations (e.g., LangChain or LlamaIndex packages), independent or hands-on corroboration.
